notes: web_search error shape: content is a single object {"type":"web_search_tool_result_error","error_code":"max_uses_exceeded"} — NOT an array (asymmetry vs the success shape). Documented error_code values: too_many_requests, invalid_tool_input, max_uses_exceeded, query_too_long, request_too_large, unavailable. Zero hits produce an empty result array, not an error.
